welcome.text: All aboard the Compound Word Express! Load the crates and build words!

instructions.text: Tap word crates to load them onto the flatbeds. Match the picture to send the train!

hint.text: Load two crates that make a new word.

correct_2.text: All aboard! The word is loaded!

correct_3.text: Toot toot! Great job building that word!

wrong_1.text: Wrong crates! The train won't move. Try again!

wrong_2.text: Oops! Those crates don't match. Try again!

halfway.text: Half the deliveries done! Keep loading!

level_up.text: Express speed! The train is picking up pace!

win.text: All deliveries complete! You're a Train Conductor!

try_again.text: Good effort! Want to ride the train again?

reset_train.text: Train reset. You can try those crates again!
